params.name: optional name of the unit
params.lineage: (parent_name, power) pairs the unit is built from

unit_vector.returns: the unit as a dict with its exponent vector

raises.ValueError: the exponent vector is not of length 7

unit_mul.doc: Multiply two units: add their exponent vectors.

unit_div.doc: Divide two units: subtract their exponent vectors.

unit_pow.doc: Raise a unit to a power: scale its exponent vector.

unit_lineage_decompose.returns: dict with the trace to the 7 SI leaves and whether it recombines to the declared exponent vector

equation_index_lookup.returns: names of the candidate equations with that signature
